Sandbox_GridInventory_ScatterMode_toolti:
How items without a saved position are placed in containers.

Automatic (natural loot): only containers that were never looted get a natural random layout; the player inventory and explored containers fill organized.

Always scatter (messy): items land scattered everywhere, including your own inventory. Quick transfers get messy; precise drag & drop with x,y keeps things organized.

Never scatter (neat): everything auto-fills from the top-left, never random.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ReorderTimeAction_:
Moves items within the same container with a short transfer animation.

Animated: the character does the transfer animation and the move is applied ~0.5s later. In multiplayer this gives the server time to process before the next move.

Instant: items move immediately on drop, like before.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ReorderMoveWhileWa:
Allows the character to walk while the item reorder action is running (running still cancels it).

On: you can walk while items reorganize, like many other timed actions.

Off: the action only runs while standing still.
Sandbox_GridInventory_SearchWorldContain:
Makes world containers (crates, shelves, corpses...) need to be searched before you can interact with the items inside, like Tarkov.

When on, opening a container hides unidentified items behind a dark mask. Click the grid to start searching: items are revealed one stack at a time. You can stop anytime and keep what you already found; click again to resume. Items you put in yourself are revealed immediately.

Off: containers always show their contents.
Sandbox_GridInventory_SearchTimePerItem_:
Time in milliseconds to reveal each stack while searching a container. Scales with the number of stacks: more items, longer search.

0 = instant (reveals everything on click).
Sandbox_GridInventory_EnableDevTools_too:
Adds the "[DevTool] Edit Grid Size" option to the item context menu, so you can resize item footprints and container grids without launching the game with -debug.

On: DevTools available in this save. In multiplayer, non-admin players can see the option but the server rejects applying changes.

Off: only available when the game is started with -debug.
